brief:
The Colonisation and Wall Resistance Commission documented seven Israeli attacks against farmers on Wednesday across four West Bank governorates within a 12-hour period, Middle East Eye reported. The incidents targeted agricultural workers across multiple locations in the occupied territory.

The attacks represent an intensification of violence against Palestinian farming communities, who face repeated Israeli military operations and settler harassment that disrupt agricultural work and access to land.
